## Pagination

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/pagination.html

Links to the pages of a long list of results.

**Our choice:** No standard exists: a labelled `<nav>` with a list of links and `aria-current="page"`, as for breadcrumbs.

_Diagram: Pagination is the row of page links under a long list of results, with the current page marked._

### Live example

#### Middle of a long list

```html
<nav aria-label="Pagination" data-pagination>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="?page=4" rel="prev">Previous<span class="visually-hidden"> page</span></a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=1"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>1</a></li>
    <li aria-hidden="true">…</li>
    <li><a href="?page=4"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>4</a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=5" aria-current="page"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>5</a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=6"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>6</a></li>
    <li aria-hidden="true">…</li>
    <li><a href="?page=10"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>10</a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=6" rel="next">Next<span class="visually-hidden"> page</span></a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

#### First page

```html
<nav aria-label="Pagination, search results" data-pagination>
  <ul>
    <li><a>Previous<span class="visually-hidden"> page</span></a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=1" aria-current="page"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>1</a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=2"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>2</a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=3"><span class="visually-hidden">Page </span>3</a></li>
    <li><a href="?page=2" rel="next">Next<span class="visually-hidden"> page</span></a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-pagination` | `<nav aria-label="Pagination">` |  |
| `aria-current="page"` | the current page link (native ARIA) |  |
| `<a> without href` |  | a disabled Previous or Next (native placeholder link) |
| `<li aria-hidden="true">…</li>` |  | a gap in the page numbers |

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves to the next page link / Shift+Tab: previous |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | follows the focused link |

### Accessibility

- A visually hidden "Page" completes each number's link name ([WCAG 2.4.4](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/link-purpose-in-context.html)).
- At the ends, Previous or Next is an `<a>` with no `href`: not focusable.
- **Our choice:** the current page stays a link with `aria-current="page"`, so the list count stays stable.

### Specifications

- [HTML `<nav>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-nav-element)
- [MDN `aria-current`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-current)
- [WHATWG link type next](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#link-type-next)
- [WHATWG the a element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/text-level-semantics.html#the-a-element)
- [WCAG Target size minimum](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html)

### See also

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/pagination.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/pagination.css), [`examples/molecules/pagination.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/pagination.html)

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- Apple Human Interface Guidelines: No equivalent
- Material Design 3: No equivalent
- [Vercel Geist: Pagination](https://vercel.com/geist/pagination)

## Popover

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/popover.html

Content shown on top of the page from a button, with the `popover` attribute.

_Diagram: A popover opens from a button, such as Share beside the page heading, as a small panel on top of the page under the button._

### Live example

#### Popover

```html
<button type="button" popovertarget="share-popover">Share</button>
<div id="share-popover" popover data-popover>
  <p>Anyone with the link can view this page.</p>
</div>
```

#### Above the button, with a close button

```html
<button type="button" popovertarget="help-popover">Help</button>
<div id="help-popover" popover="manual" data-popover="block-start">
  <p><strong>Need a hand?</strong></p>
  <p>Read the <a href="#above-title">guide</a> or ask in the forum.</p>
  <button type="button" popovertarget="help-popover" popovertargetaction="hide" data-button="small">Close</button>
</div>
```

#### Tooltip

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <dui-tooltip>
    <button type="button" aria-describedby="save-tip">Save</button>
    <span id="save-tip" popover="hint" role="tooltip">Shortcut: Ctrl+S</span>
  </dui-tooltip>
  <dui-tooltip>
    <button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" aria-describedby="copy-tip" data-button="quiet">⧉</button>
    <span id="copy-tip" popover="hint" role="tooltip">Copies the page address</span>
  </dui-tooltip>
</div>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-popover` | a `[popover]` element | panel look, anchored below the invoker, aligned to its start edge |
| `data-popover="block-start \| inline-start \| inline-end"` |  | place it above or beside the invoker instead |
| `role="tooltip"` | a `[popover]` element | tooltip look, placed above the trigger |
| `popover="auto \| manual \| hint"` |  | native: auto light-dismisses, manual does not |

#### Positioning

A popover opened by popovertarget (or by showPopover() with a source) has its invoker as an implicit anchor, so position-area places it next to the button and position-try-fallbacks flips it when it would overflow. Inside @supports only; where anchor positioning is missing the popover sits centered at the bottom of the viewport, readable and clear of the content it belongs to.

#### Tooltip

`role="tooltip"` on a `popover="hint"` element, referenced from the trigger with `aria-describedby`. The APG Tooltip pattern is still marked as work in progress, so these rules come from it and from WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus:

- A tooltip supplements the trigger's own accessible name; it is never the only label, because touch and some assistive technology users never see it;
- It appears on keyboard focus as well as on hover;
- Esc hides it without moving focus (dismissible), the pointer can move onto it without it closing (hoverable), and it stays until focus or the pointer leaves (persistent);
- It holds no interactive content (use a popover for that).

HTML cannot show a popover on hover or focus yet: the interestfor attribute is the coming standard, shipped only in Chromium today. Until it is interoperable, the `<dui-tooltip>` web component (`web-components/dui-tooltip.js`) does the showing and hiding. `popover="hint"` does not close other open popovers; where "hint" is unsupported the attribute falls back to "manual" and the component still handles Esc.

#### Motion

A `data-popover` panel fades and grows from `--dui-motion-zoom` over `--dui-motion-duration-fast`, entering with `--dui-motion-easing-enter` and leaving with `--dui-motion-easing-exit` (`@starting-style` and transition-behavior: allow-discrete). The zoom runs for that duration times `--dui-motion-movement`, so reduced motion keeps only the fade (WCAG 2.3.3). Tooltips appear at once.

#### Elevation

Panels use `--dui-elevation-popover` and `--dui-elevation-popover-surface`; tooltips use the popover shadow on their inverse surface. The role's 1px ring draws the edge. Both keep a transparent border, which forced colors mode paints in place of the dropped shadow.

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | on a popover button, opens or closes the popover |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves into the open popover, then on through the page |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | closes an auto popover and returns focus to its button |
| <kbd>Tab to a tooltip trigger</kbd> | shows its tooltip / Esc: hides it, focus stays |

### Accessibility

- A popover does not trap focus; decisions belong in a modal `<dialog>`. For actions, use the [menu button](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/menu-button.md).
- A tooltip supplements the trigger's name, shows on focus and hover, and closes on <kbd>Esc</kbd> ([WCAG 1.4.13](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/content-on-hover-or-focus.html); [APG Tooltip](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tooltip/) is a draft).

### Specifications

- [HTML `popover` attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/popover.html#the-popover-attribute)
- [MDN Popover API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API)
- [WHATWG popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/popover.html)
- [MDN `popover`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Global_attributes/popover)
- [MDN CSS anchor positioning](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_anchor_positioning)
- [MDN `position-area`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/position-area)
- [MDN `position-try-fallbacks`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/position-try-fallbacks)
- [W3C css anchor position 1](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position-1/)
- [Open UI interest invokers.explainer](https://open-ui.org/components/interest-invokers.explainer/)

### See also

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/popover.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/popover.css), [`examples/molecules/popover.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/popover.html)
- Demos: Dashboard view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/index.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/DashboardPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/dashboard), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/index.astro)); Account settings view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/settings.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/SettingsPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/settings), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/settings.astro)); Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

## Search

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/search.html

A search form in a `<search>` landmark with an `<input type="search">`.

_Diagram: Site search sits in the app bar as a search input with a Search button; a labelled search form can also head a page of results._

### Live example

#### With a visible label

```html
<search aria-label="Guides">
  <form action="search.html" method="get">
    <label for="guide-search">Search the guides</label>
    <input id="guide-search" type="search" name="q" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="guide-search-hint">
    <button type="submit">Search</button>
    <p id="guide-search-hint" data-field="hint">Try "tokens" or "dialog".</p>
  </form>
</search>
```

#### Compact, label visually hidden

```html
<search aria-label="Site">
  <form action="search.html" method="get">
    <label for="site-search" class="visually-hidden">Search this site</label>
    <input id="site-search" type="search" name="q" autocomplete="off">
    <button type="submit" data-button="secondary">Search</button>
  </form>
</search>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `<search> > <form> with an <input type="search">` | no attribute needed: the label and any hint span the full width, the input and the submit button share the row below. |

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | in the field, submits the search |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | in the field, clears it (in browsers that support it) |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves from the field to the button |

### Accessibility

- `<search>` is a landmark; label it only when there are several.
- The input needs a `<label>`, visually hidden if space is short; a placeholder is not a label ([WCAG 3.3.2](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/labels-or-instructions.html)).

### Specifications

- [HTML `<search>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/grouping-content.html#the-search-element)
- [MDN `<input type="search">`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input/search)
- [MDN `<search>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/search)
- [W3C labels](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/forms/labels/)

### See also

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/search.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/search.css), [`examples/molecules/search.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/search.html)

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- [Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Search fields](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/search-fields)
- [Material Design 3: Search](https://m3.material.io/components/search/overview)
- [Vercel Geist: Search Input](https://vercel.com/geist/search-input)

## Site navigation

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/nav.html

The main links of a site in a `<nav>` landmark, with the current page marked.

_Diagram: Site navigation is the list of main links in the sidebar, with the current page marked, or a short row of links in the app bar._

### Live example

#### Vertical (sidebar)

```html
<nav aria-label="Sidebar example" data-nav="vertical">
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#vertical-title">Overview</a></li>
    <li>
      <details open>
        <summary>Projects</summary>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#vertical-title" aria-current="page">Active</a></li>
          <li><a href="#vertical-title">Archived</a></li>
        </ul>
      </details>
    </li>
    <li>
      <details>
        <summary>Settings</summary>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#vertical-title">Profile</a></li>
          <li><a href="#vertical-title">Billing</a></li>
        </ul>
      </details>
    </li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

#### Horizontal (top bar)

```html
<nav aria-label="Top bar example" data-nav="horizontal">
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#horizontal-title" aria-current="page">Home</a></li>
    <li>
      <details name="top-bar">
        <summary>Products</summary>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#horizontal-title">Design system</a></li>
          <li><a href="#horizontal-title">Icons</a></li>
        </ul>
      </details>
    </li>
    <li>
      <details name="top-bar">
        <summary>Company</summary>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#horizontal-title">About</a></li>
          <li><a href="#horizontal-title">Careers</a></li>
        </ul>
      </details>
    </li>
    <li><a href="#horizontal-title">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-nav="vertical \| horizontal"` | `<nav>` (empty means vertical) |  |
| `aria-current="page"` | the current link (native ARIA) |  |
| `aria-current="true"` | a top-level horizontal link to the current section | marked like "page" |
| `<details> / <summary>` |  | inside an `<li>` for a collapsible group; open to expand it on load, name for one-at-a-time |

#### Elevation

Horizontal dropdowns use `--dui-elevation-popover` and its surface, like a popover. They open at once: native details has no open transition.

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves to the next link or group summary / Shift+Tab: previous |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | on a summary, opens or closes the group |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | on a link, follows it |

### Accessibility

- Native `<details>` in place of the [APG disclosure navigation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/examples/disclosure-navigation/); not an ARIA menu.
- [`aria-current="page"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-current) is shown with a bar, a tint and bold text ([WCAG 1.4.1](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html)).
- Give each `<nav>` a distinct `aria-label` when there are several.
- Groups do not close on <kbd>Esc</kbd>; <kbd>Enter</kbd> on the summary does.

### Specifications

- [HTML `<nav>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-nav-element)
- [APG Landmark regions](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/landmark-regions/)
- [APG Disclosure navigation example](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/examples/disclosure-navigation/)
- [MDN `aria-current`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-current)
- [MDN `nav`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/nav)
- [WCAG F73](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/failures/F73)
- [APG treeview](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/treeview/)
- [WHATWG the details element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#the-details-element)
- [WCAG Non text contrast](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-contrast.html)

### See also

- [Organisms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/organisms/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/nav.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/nav.css), [`examples/molecules/nav.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/nav.html)
- Demos: Dashboard view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/index.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/DashboardPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/dashboard), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/index.astro)); Account settings view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/settings.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/SettingsPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/settings), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/settings.astro)); Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- Apple Human Interface Guidelines: No equivalent
- Material Design 3: No equivalent
- Vercel Geist: No equivalent

## Tabs

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/tabs.html

Sections of content shown one at a time, chosen from a list of tabs.

_Diagram: Tabs are a row of labels under a heading in the content area, with the panel of the selected tab right below them._

### Live example

#### Automatic activation

```html
<dui-tabs>
  <nav aria-label="Account settings">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="#tab-profile">Profile</a></li>
      <li><a href="#tab-security">Security</a></li>
      <li><a href="#tab-notifications">Notifications</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <section id="tab-profile">
    <h3>Profile</h3>
    <p>Your name and photo appear on comments and shared projects.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="tab-security">
    <h3>Security</h3>
    <div data-field>
      <label for="tab-security-code">Recovery code</label>
      <input id="tab-security-code" name="recovery" type="text" autocomplete="off">
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="tab-notifications">
    <h3>Notifications</h3>
    <p>Email alerts are on. You get a weekly digest on Mondays.</p>
  </section>
</dui-tabs>
```

#### Manual activation

```html
<dui-tabs activation="manual">
  <nav aria-label="Report period">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="#tab-week">Week</a></li>
      <li><a href="#tab-month" aria-current="true">Month</a></li>
      <li><a href="#tab-year">Year</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <section id="tab-week">
    <h3>Week</h3>
    <p>42 orders this week.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="tab-month">
    <h3>Month</h3>
    <p>180 orders this month.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="tab-year">
    <h3>Year</h3>
    <p>2,140 orders this year.</p>
  </section>
</dui-tabs>
```

#### Right to left

```html
<div dir="rtl" lang="ar">
  <dui-tabs>
    <nav aria-label="الإعدادات">
      <ul>
        <li><a href="#tab-rtl-general">عام</a></li>
        <li><a href="#tab-rtl-privacy">الخصوصية</a></li>
        <li><a href="#tab-rtl-help">مساعدة</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
    <section id="tab-rtl-general">
      <h3>عام</h3>
      <p>الإعدادات العامة للحساب.</p>
    </section>
    <section id="tab-rtl-privacy">
      <h3>الخصوصية</h3>
      <p>من يمكنه رؤية ملفك الشخصي.</p>
    </section>
    <section id="tab-rtl-help">
      <h3>مساعدة</h3>
      <p>الأسئلة الشائعة والدعم.</p>
    </section>
  </dui-tabs>
</div>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<dui-tabs>` |  | wraps a `<nav aria-label>` with a list of `<a href="#panel-id">` links, then the panels |
| `activation="manual"` | `<dui-tabs>` | arrows move focus, Enter or Space selects (default: automatic) |
| `aria-current="true"` | a link | the tab selected on load (else the tab named in the URL fragment, else the first) |
| `role="tablist" \| "tab" \| "tabpanel"` |  | added by the component; styled here |

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves into the tab list (to the selected tab), then to the panel |
| <kbd>Right Arrow</kbd> / <kbd>Left Arrow</kbd> | next or previous tab, wrapping (swapped in right-to-left) |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | first or last tab |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | selects the focused tab (manual activation) |

### Accessibility

- The selected tab has a bar and full-strength text, not color alone ([WCAG 1.4.11](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-contrast.html)).
- Without JavaScript, every section shows and the links work as a table of contents.
- **Our choice:** automatic activation, as the [APG recommends](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/#deciding-when-to-make-selection-automatically-follow-focus) for fast panels; `activation="manual"` otherwise.

### Specifications

- [APG Tabs pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/)
- [MDN `tab` role](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/tab_role)
- [MDN `tabpanel` role](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/tabpanel_role)
- [W3C el nav](https://www.w3.org/TR/html-aria/#el-nav)

### See also

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/tabs.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/tabs.css), [`examples/molecules/tabs.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/tabs.html)

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- [Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Tab views](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tab-views)
- [Material Design 3: Tabs](https://m3.material.io/components/tabs/overview)
- [Vercel Geist: Tabs](https://vercel.com/geist/tabs)

## Toolbar

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/toolbar.html

A row of related controls that is one stop in the tab order.

_Diagram: A toolbar is a row of related buttons at the top of the area it acts on, such as the formatting buttons above a text editor._

### Live example

#### Text formatting

```html
<dui-toolbar role="toolbar" aria-label="Text formatting">
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="true">Bold</button>
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Italic</button>
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Underline</button>
  <hr>
  <button type="button">Insert link</button>
  <button type="button">Clear formatting</button>
</dui-toolbar>
```

#### Vertical

```html
<dui-toolbar role="toolbar" aria-label="Drawing tools" aria-orientation="vertical">
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="true">Select</button>
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Pen</button>
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Eraser</button>
</dui-toolbar>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `role="toolbar" aria-label="…"` | the container (`<dui-toolbar>` or any element) |  |
| `aria-orientation="vertical"` |  | optional; default horizontal |
| `aria-pressed="true \| false"` | toggle buttons (native ARIA) |  |
| `<hr>` |  | a separator between groups of controls |

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves into the toolbar (to the last focused control), then out of it |
| <kbd>Right Arrow</kbd> / <kbd>Left Arrow</kbd> | next or previous control, wrapping (swapped in right-to-left) |
| <kbd>Down Arrow</kbd> / <kbd>Up Arrow</kbd> | the same in a vertical toolbar |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | first or last control |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | activates the focused button |

### Accessibility

- Use a toolbar for three or more controls. Without JavaScript, each control is a Tab stop.
- Toggle buttons use [`aria-pressed`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-pressed), shown by more than color ([WCAG 1.4.1](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html)).

### Specifications

- [APG Toolbar pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/toolbar/)
- [MDN `toolbar` role](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/toolbar_role)
- [APG kbd roving tabindex](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/#kbd_roving_tabindex)

### See also

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/toolbar.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/toolbar.css), [`examples/molecules/toolbar.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/toolbar.html)
- Demos: Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- [Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Toolbars](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/toolbars)
- [Material Design 3: Toolbars](https://m3.material.io/components/toolbars/overview)
- Vercel Geist: No equivalent

## Typeahead

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/typeahead.html

A text field that suggests values as you type: `<datalist>` first, an APG combobox where it falls short.

_Diagram: A typeahead is a text field in a form whose list of suggestions opens right under it as you type._

### Live example

#### Typeahead

```html
<dui-combobox>
  <label for="city">City</label>
  <input type="text" id="city" name="city" list="city-options">
  <datalist id="city-options">
    <option value="Amsterdam"></option>
    <option value="Athens"></option>
    <option value="Berlin"></option>
    <option value="Bern"></option>
    <option value="Brussels"></option>
    <option value="Copenhagen"></option>
    <option value="Dublin"></option>
    <option value="Lisbon"></option>
    <option value="Madrid"></option>
    <option value="Oslo"></option>
    <option value="Paris"></option>
    <option value="Rome"></option>
    <option value="Vienna"></option>
  </datalist>
</dui-combobox>
```

#### Typeahead in a form

```html
<form id="ship-form" class="stack">
  <dui-combobox>
    <label for="carrier">Carrier</label>
    <input type="text" id="carrier" name="carrier" list="carrier-options" required>
    <datalist id="carrier-options">
      <option value="DHL Express" label="Next day"></option>
      <option value="DPD Classic" label="2 to 3 days"></option>
      <option value="FedEx International" label="Next day"></option>
      <option value="PostNL Parcel" label="1 to 2 days"></option>
      <option value="UPS Standard" label="2 to 5 days"></option>
    </datalist>
  </dui-combobox>
  <p><button type="submit">Ship order</button></p>
  <p role="status" id="ship-result"></p>
</form>
```

#### Options loaded by the page

```html
<dui-combobox id="country-combobox">
  <label for="country">Country</label>
  <input type="text" id="country" name="country" list="country-options">
  <datalist id="country-options"></datalist>
</dui-combobox>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `<dui-combobox>` | wraps a `<label>`, an `<input list>` and its `<datalist>` |
| `<option value="…" label="…">` | the suggestions; an optional label shows as a hint |
| `dui-combobox-filter` | event, cancelable, detail { query }: cancel it to load options yourself |
| `element.setOptions([...])` | replaces the options: strings or { value, label } objects |

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Down Arrow</kbd> | opens the list and moves to the next option (the first if none) |
| <kbd>Up Arrow</kbd> | opens the list and moves to the previous option (the last if none) |
| <kbd>Alt+Down Arrow</kbd> | opens the list without moving to an option |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | accepts the active option and closes the list |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | closes the list; if it is already closed, clears the input |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | moves the caret to the start or end of the input; the list loses its active option |
| <kbd>Typing</kbd> | filters the options |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | closes the list without accepting an option |

### Accessibility

- A text field that suggests values as you type, following the APG Combobox pattern, list autocomplete variant: the input keeps focus, a listbox of matching options opens below it, and the arrow keys move an active option shown with aria-activedescendant.
- The listbox is exactly as wide as the combobox, so it never overflows the viewport sideways (WCAG 1.4.10), and it needs neither anchor positioning nor the popover fallback that centers a panel at the bottom of the viewport.
- The input has role="combobox", aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded and aria-controls; the list is role="listbox", named by the label, with role="option" items.
- Focus never leaves the input; the active option is aria-activedescendant and has aria-selected="true", and it is drawn with an outline in the focus color (3:1, WCAG 1.4.11) and a tint, so it does not rely on color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
- A polite role="status" region, in the page from the upgrade on, announces how many options match after typing pauses (WCAG 4.1.3).
- Options are at least --dui-size-control tall (44px, 32px compact; WCAG 2.5.8).
- In forced colors mode the list keeps its border and the active option its outline, in system colors.
- The list fades and grows from --dui-motion-zoom over --dui-motion-duration-fast, entering with --dui-motion-easing-enter and leaving with --dui-motion-easing-exit; the zoom runs for that duration times --dui-motion-movement, so reduced motion keeps only the fade (WCAG 2.3.3).

### Specifications

- [HTML `<datalist>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-datalist-element)
- [APG Combobox pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/)
- [MDN `<datalist>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/datalist)
- [APG combobox autocomplete list](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-autocomplete-list/)
- [MDN `combobox` role](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/combobox_role)
- [MDN `listbox` role](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/listbox_role)
- [WCAG Status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html)
- [WCAG Target size minimum](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html)

### See also

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/molecules/combobox.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/molecules/combobox.css), [`examples/molecules/combobox.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/molecules/combobox.html)
- Demos: Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- [Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Combo boxes](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/combo-boxes)
- Material Design 3: No equivalent
- [Vercel Geist: Combobox](https://vercel.com/geist/combobox)

## App shell

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/app-shell.html

The frame of an application: header, primary sidebar, main content and an optional auxiliary sidebar.

**Our choice:** No standard defines an app shell: the landmarks `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>` and `<aside>`, placed with CSS grid.

_Diagram: The app shell is the whole frame of an app: the app bar across the top, the primary sidebar, the main content and an optional auxiliary sidebar._

### Live example

#### Sidebar navigation with icons

```html
<nav id="app-nav" aria-label="Main" data-nav="vertical">
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a href="?view=home">
        <!-- Lucide: house -->
        <svg data-icon xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">

      </a>
    </li>
```

#### Auxiliary sidebar: the selected order

```html
<aside id="app-aux" aria-label="Order details" class="stack">
  <h2 id="aux-title">Order 1042</h2>
  <p><span data-badge="accent" id="aux-status">Shipped</span></p>
  <dl>
    <dt>Customer</dt>
    <dd id="aux-customer">Analytical Engines Ltd.</dd>
    <dt>Placed</dt>
    <dd id="aux-placed"><time datetime="2025-03-12">12 Mar 2025</time></dd>
    <dt>Total</dt>
    <dd id="aux-total">€1,240.00</dd>
    <dt>Ship to</dt>
    <dd id="aux-ship">12 St James's Square, London</dd>
    <dt>Carrier</dt>
    <dd id="aux-carrier">DHL Express</dd>
  </dl>
  <p class="cluster">
    <a href="?order=1042&amp;view=edit" id="aux-open" data-button>Open order</a>
    <a href="?order=1042&amp;view=print" id="aux-print" data-button>Print</a>
  </p>
  <p role="status" class="visually-hidden" id="aux-announce"></p>
</aside>
```

#### Contained app shell

```html
<dui-app-shell data-app-shell="contained" style="--dui-size-pane: 36rem">
  <header aria-label="Northwind">
    <button type="button" aria-controls="demo-nav" aria-expanded="true" hidden>Menu</button>
    <a href="?view=home" data-link="quiet"><strong>Northwind</strong></a>
    <button type="button" aria-controls="demo-aux" aria-expanded="true" hidden>Activity</button>
  </header>
  <nav id="demo-nav" aria-label="Main" data-nav="vertical">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="?view=home">Home</a></li>
      <li>
        <details open>
          <summary>Customers</summary>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="?view=accounts" aria-current="page">Accounts</a></li>
            <li><a href="?view=contacts">Contacts</a></li>
          </ul>
        </details>
      </li>
      <li>
        <details>
          <summary>Sales</summary>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="?view=orders">Orders</a></li>
            <li><a href="?view=invoices">Invoices</a></li>
          </ul>
        </details>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <main id="main" class="stack">
    <header data-page-header>
      <h2>Accounts</h2>
      <p>Customers with an open balance.</p>
      <div><a href="?view=new-account" data-button="primary">New account</a></div>
    </header>
    <div data-list-detail>
      <nav aria-label="Accounts">
        <ul>
          <li><a href="?account=c-118" aria-current="page">Analytical Engines Ltd. <small>London</small></a></li>
          <li><a href="?account=c-117">Bletchley Instruments <small>Milton Keynes</small></a></li>
          <li><a href="?account=c-116">Cobol Systems BV <small>Utrecht</small></a></li>
        </ul>
      </nav>
      <article aria-labelledby="account-118-title">
        <h3 id="account-118-title">Analytical Engines Ltd.</h3>
        <dl>
          <dt>Contact</dt>
          <dd>Ada Lovelace</dd>
          <dt>Open balance</dt>
          <dd>€1,240.00</dd>
        </dl>
      </article>
    </div>
  </main>
  <aside id="demo-aux" aria-label="Activity">
    <h2>Activity</h2>
    <ol>
      <li>Invoice INV-0318 sent, 12 March</li>
      <li>Order 1042 shipped, 12 March</li>
      <li>Payment received, 3 March</li>
    </ol>
  </aside>
</dui-app-shell>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-app-shell` | a wrapper (or `<dui-app-shell>`), after the skip link |  |
| `data-app-shell="contained"` |  | the shell is `--dui-size-pane` tall and scrolls inside its own box (a shell inside a page section) |

Children, in source order:

| Attribute or value | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `<header>` | the app bar: app name, toggles, search, user menu |
| `<nav aria-label> or <aside aria-label>` | the primary sidebar (before `<main>`) |
| `<main id>` | the content |
| `<aside aria-label>` | optional auxiliary sidebar (after `<main>`) |
| `<footer>` | optional |
| `<button type="button" aria-controls="sidebar-id" aria-expanded="true" hidden>` | a sidebar's toggle; `<dui-app-shell>` shows it. `aria-expanded="false"` in the markup starts the sidebar collapsed when it sits beside main |
| `--dui-size-sidebar, --dui-size-sidebar-aux` | sidebar widths beside main |
| `--dui-size-pane` | max block size of a sidebar beside main; the block size of a contained shell |

#### Motion

Collapsing and expanding a sidebar beside main animates the grid columns for `--dui-motion-duration-slow` times `--dui-motion-movement`, so reduced motion and `data-motion="none"` make it instant (WCAG 2.3.3); the drawer is `dialog.css`'s drawer and moves like it. Elevation: the app bar and sidebars are on the page (flat) and separated by hairlines; the drawer is at the dialog level.

#### Breakpoints

The primary sidebar sits beside main from 48rem of the shell's own inline size, the auxiliary sidebar from 64rem (between the two it stacks under main, or is a drawer with the script). A container query condition cannot read a custom property, so both are lengths; `web-components/dui-app-shell.js` uses the same two numbers.

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | skip link, app bar, primary sidebar, main, auxiliary sidebar (source order) |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | on a toggle, collapses or expands its sidebar; when the shell is narrow, opens it as a drawer |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | in a drawer, closes it and returns focus to its toggle |

### Accessibility

- Without JavaScript both are always visible: stacked above and below main when narrow, beside it when wide.
- Toggle buttons are native buttons with aria-controls and aria-expanded (APG Disclosure); they carry the hidden attribute in the markup and the script shows them, so there is never a button that does nothing.
- A collapsed sidebar has the hidden attribute, so it is gone for assistive technology and the Tab order as well.
- Sidebars that sit beside main stick to the top of the scroll area and scroll on their own, at most --dui-size-pane tall; their columns run to the end of the shell and the footer sits between them, so they never cover it.
- They are not focus traps and hold focusable links, so the keyboard reaches everything in them (WCAG 2.1.1).
- Nothing scrolls sideways at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10): the app bar wraps, the search taking its own row.

- [APG Landmark regions](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/landmark-regions/)
- [HTML `<main>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/grouping-content.html#the-main-element)
- [HTML `<aside>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-aside-element)
- [WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html)
- [MDN `grid-template-areas`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/grid-template-areas)

## Compact density

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/density.html

A compact density token that tightens spacing for data-heavy screens.

**Our choice:** No standard exists: `data-density="compact"` on any ancestor re-derives the density tokens; text size never changes and targets stay at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

_Diagram: Compact density tightens a data-heavy area such as a table, so it shows more rows in the same height than a comfortable table beside it._

### Live example

#### Comfortable and compact

```html
<div class="grid" style="--grid-min: 20rem">

    <h3 id="comfortable-title">Comfortable (default)</h3>
    <dui-toolbar role="toolbar" aria-label="Order actions (comfortable)">
      <button type="button">New order</button>
      <button type="button">Export</button>

      <button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Show archived</button>

    <form class="stack" aria-labelledby="comfortable-form-title comfortable-title">
      <h4 id="comfortable-form-title">Edit order</h4>

        <label for="comfortable-customer">Customer</label>
        <input type="text" id="comfortable-customer" name="customer" value="Ada Lovelace" autocomplete="off">
      </div>
```

## Dashboard

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/dashboard.html

A grid of summary sections, each with a heading, that reflows to fit the screen.

**Our choice:** No standard exists: a CSS grid of headed `<section>` elements that reflows without media queries.

_Diagram: A dashboard fills the content area with a grid of headed summary sections, such as totals and a chart, that reflow to fit._

### Live example

#### Sales overview

```html
<div data-dashboard>
  <section aria-labelledby="tile-open-title">
    <h3 id="tile-open-title">Open orders</h3>
    <p><strong>128</strong> orders, 12 due to ship today</p>
    <p><a href="?view=orders&amp;status=open">View open orders</a></p>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="tile-overdue-title">
    <h3 id="tile-overdue-title">Overdue invoices</h3>
    <p><strong>€8,420.50</strong> across 7 invoices</p>
    <p><span data-badge="warning">3 over 60 days</span></p>
    <p><a href="?view=invoices&amp;status=overdue">View overdue invoices</a></p>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="tile-revenue-title">
    <h3 id="tile-revenue-title">Revenue in March</h3>
    <p><strong>€142,300</strong>, up 6% on February</p>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="tile-quotes-title">
    <h3 id="tile-quotes-title">Quotes to approve</h3>
    <p><strong>5</strong> quotes worth €21,700</p>
    <p><a href="?view=quotes&amp;status=pending">Review quotes</a></p>
  </section>
  <section data-dashboard="wide" aria-labelledby="tile-recent-title">
    <h3 id="tile-recent-title">Recent invoices</h3>
    <section data-scroll="inline" aria-labelledby="recent-invoices" tabindex="0">
      <table>
        <caption id="recent-invoices">Last four invoices</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr><th scope="col">Invoice</th><th scope="col">Customer</th><th scope="col">Status</th><th scope="col">Amount</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>INV-2025-0318</td><td>Analytical Engines Ltd.</td><td>Part paid</td><td>€1,240.00</td></tr>
          <tr><td>INV-2025-0317</td><td>Cobol Systems BV</td><td>Paid</td><td>€3,980.00</td></tr>
          <tr><td>INV-2025-0316</td><td>Orbital Mechanics GmbH</td><td>Overdue</td><td>€615.90</td></tr>
          <tr><td>INV-2025-0315</td><td>Bletchley Instruments</td><td>Paid</td><td>€48.50</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="tile-stock-title">
    <h3 id="tile-stock-title">Stock alerts</h3>
    <ul>
      <li>Brass gear set: 6 left</li>
      <li>Punch card reader: 2 left</li>
    </ul>
    <p><a href="?view=stock&amp;filter=low">Reorder stock</a></p>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="tile-shipments-title">
    <h3 id="tile-shipments-title">Shipments in transit</h3>
    <p><strong>23</strong> parcels, 2 delayed at customs</p>
    <p><a href="?view=shipments">Track shipments</a></p>
  </section>
  <section data-dashboard="full" aria-labelledby="tile-tasks-title">
    <h3 id="tile-tasks-title">Tasks for today</h3>
    <p>Approve credit note CN-2025-0013, call Orbital Mechanics GmbH about invoice INV-2025-0316, and confirm the April price list.</p>
  </section>
</div>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-dashboard` | the wrapper (a `<div>`, or a `<ul>` of tiles) |  |
| `data-dashboard="wide"` | a tile | two columns when they fit, else one |
| `data-dashboard="full"` | a tile | the whole row |

Tiles: `<section aria-labelledby>` (or `<article>`, `<li>`) with a heading first.

#### Elevation

Tiles use `--dui-elevation-raised` and its surface (level 1), whose 1px ring draws the edge, and a transparent border that forced colors mode paints in canvastext.

#### Breakpoint

A wide tile spans two columns from 33.5rem of the wrapper's own inline size (two 16rem columns and the 1.5rem gap). A container query condition cannot read a custom property, so it is written as a length.

### Accessibility

- Tiles keep source order whatever the column count, so the reading and Tab order never jump (WCAG 1.3.2, 2.4.3).
- Figures in a tile are text, not only color (WCAG 1.4.1).
- Nothing scrolls sideways at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10); wrap a table in a tile in data-scroll="inline".

### Specifications

- [MDN CSS grid layout](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Grid_layout)
- [WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html)
- [MDN `auto-fit`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/repeat#auto-fit)
- [MDN Container queries](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Containment/Container_queries)

- [Layouts](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/index.md)
- Source: [`css/layout/dashboard.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/dashboard.css), [`examples/layouts/dashboard.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/layouts/dashboard.html)
- Demos: Dashboard view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/index.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/DashboardPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/dashboard), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/index.astro))

```html
            <td>Difference Engine Works</td>
            <td><time datetime="2025-02-27">27 Feb 2025</time></td>
            <td><span data-badge="success">Delivered</span></td>
            <td data-table="number">€310.25</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td><label><input type="checkbox" name="orders[]" value="1037"><span class="visually-hidden">Select order 1037</span></label></td>
            <th scope="row">1037</th>
            <td>Hollerith Tabulating Co.</td>
            <td><time datetime="2025-03-01">1 Mar 2025</time></td>

          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  </dui-table>
</form>
<p role="status" id="bulk-result"></p>
```

#### Empty state

```html

      <tr>

        <th scope="col">Customer</th>

      <tr>
        <td colspan="5">
          <p>No orders match these filters</p>
          <p>Try another status or date, or <a href="?">clear the filters</a>.</p>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</section>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-table` | the `<table>` | header surface, sort buttons, selection, empty and loading states |
| `data-table="sticky"` | the `<table>` | the header row sticks to the nearest scroll container |
| `data-table="number"` | every `<th>` and `<td>` of a numeric column | end-aligned, tabular, no wrapping |
| `data-table="sortable"` | a `<thead>` `<th>` | `<dui-table>` turns its text into a sort button |
| `aria-sort="ascending \| descending"` | the sorted `<th>` only (native ARIA) |  |
| `aria-busy="true"` | the `<table>` while rows load |  |

#### Cells

Words on the table cannot target a column, so number and sortable go on cells, with the same attribute.

#### Selection

A `<label>` with a checkbox and visually hidden text naming the row ("Select order 1042") in the first cell of each body row, and an empty first header cell, where `<dui-table>` adds the "select all" checkbox.

#### Empty

One row with a single `<td colspan>` holding a message and an optional action.

#### Loading

`aria-busy="true"` on the table and skeleton rows of empty `<td>`s with `aria-hidden="true"`; the empty cells show as bars.

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves to the scroll container, then each sort button and checkbox |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | on a sort button, sorts by that column (again: reverses) |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | on a checkbox, selects or deselects the row (or every row) |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | scroll the focused scroll container |

### Accessibility

- Our choice: sortable headers are plain text in the markup and the script turns them into buttons, so with JavaScript off there are no buttons that do nothing; the rows keep the server's order, which aria-sort in the markup can state.
- Our choice: a selected row is marked by its checked checkbox, a bar on its leading edge and a tinted background, so selection never relies on color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
- The rows stay rows of a table, not a grid: aria-selected is only allowed on rows of a grid or treegrid, so the checkbox carries the state.
- The scroll container (or the page) gets a scroll-padding-block-start the height of the header, so a focused checkbox is never hidden under it (WCAG 2.4.11).
- Each row checkbox has a name that says which row it selects ("Select order 1042"), from a visually hidden label text; the selection count is a role="status" region present from page load, so changes are announced politely (WCAG 4.1.3).
- A loading table has aria-busy="true" and its skeleton rows have aria-hidden="true", so a screen reader hears the caption, the column headers and the page's status message ("Loading orders"), not blank cells.
- The skeleton shimmer stops under reduced motion and data-motion="none".
- Header buttons and checkbox labels are --dui-size-control tall (44px, 32px compact), above the 24px of WCAG 2.5.8.
- Those make the table an APG Grid, which this is not.

### Specifications

- [HTML `<table>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-table-element)
- [APG Table pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/)
- [WAI Tables tutorial](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/tables/)
- [APG Grid pattern, only if cells become interactive](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/grid/)
- [APG sortable table](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/examples/sortable-table/)
- [MDN `aria-sort`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-sort)
- [MDN `aria-busy`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-busy)
- [MDN sticky positioning](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/position#sticky_positioning)
- [WCAG Status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html)
- [WCAG Focus not obscured minimum](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-not-obscured-minimum.html)

### See also

- [Organisms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/organisms/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/organisms/data-table.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/organisms/data-table.css), [`examples/organisms/data-table.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/organisms/data-table.html)
- Demos: Dashboard view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/index.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/DashboardPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/dashboard), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/index.astro)); Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- [Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Lists and tables](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/lists-and-tables)
- Material Design 3: No equivalent
- [Vercel Geist: Table](https://vercel.com/geist/table)

## Filter bar

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/filter-bar.html

A row of native form controls that narrows a list or table.

**Our choice:** No standard exists: a `<form>` in `<search>` with labelled controls, and the result count as a status message.

_Diagram: The filter bar is a row of form controls above a list or table in the content area, with the result count after it._

### Live example

#### Filter orders

```html
<search data-filter-bar aria-label="Filter orders">
  <form method="get" id="order-filters">
    <div data-field>
      <label for="filter-q">Search orders</label>
      <input type="search" id="filter-q" name="q" placeholder="Order number">
    </div>
    <div data-field>
      <label for="filter-status">Status</label>
      <select id="filter-status" name="status">
        <option value="">Any status</option>
        <option>Open</option>
        <option>Shipped</option>
        <option>Delivered</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <dui-combobox>
      <label for="filter-customer">Customer</label>
      <input type="text" id="filter-customer" name="customer" list="filter-customers">
      <datalist id="filter-customers">
        <option value="Analytical Engines Ltd."></option>
        <option value="Bletchley Instruments"></option>
        <option value="Cobol Systems BV"></option>
        <option value="Orbital Mechanics GmbH"></option>
      </datalist>
    </dui-combobox>
    <div data-field>
      <label for="filter-from">Placed on or after</label>
      <input type="date" id="filter-from" name="from">
    </div>
    <div>
      <button type="submit">Apply</button>
      <button type="reset">Reset</button>
    </div>
  </form>
  <p role="status" id="order-count">6 orders</p>
</search>
<section data-scroll="inline" aria-labelledby="orders-caption" tabindex="0">
  <table id="order-table">
    <caption id="orders-caption">Orders</caption>
    <thead>
      <tr><th scope="col">Order</th><th scope="col">Customer</th><th scope="col">Status</th><th scope="col">Placed</th><th scope="col">Total</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
        <tr><td>1042</td><td>Analytical Engines Ltd.</td><td>Shipped</td><td><time datetime="2025-03-12">2025-03-12</time></td><td>€1,240.00</td></tr>
        <tr><td>1041</td><td>Bletchley Instruments</td><td>Delivered</td><td><time datetime="2025-03-10">2025-03-10</time></td><td>€48.50</td></tr>
        <tr><td>1040</td><td>Cobol Systems BV</td><td>Open</td><td><time datetime="2025-03-09">2025-03-09</time></td><td>€3,980.00</td></tr>
        <tr><td>1039</td><td>Orbital Mechanics GmbH</td><td>Open</td><td><time datetime="2025-03-07">2025-03-07</time></td><td>€615.90</td></tr>
        <tr><td>1038</td><td>Analytical Engines Ltd.</td><td>Delivered</td><td><time datetime="2025-03-04">2025-03-04</time></td><td>€310.25</td></tr>
        <tr><td>1037</td><td>Cobol Systems BV</td><td>Shipped</td><td><time datetime="2025-03-01">2025-03-01</time></td><td>€72.00</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</section>
```

#### Compact filter bar

```html
<div data-density="compact">
  <search data-filter-bar aria-label="Filter invoices">
    <form method="get">
      <div data-field>
        <label for="invoice-q">Search invoices</label>
        <input type="search" id="invoice-q" name="q" placeholder="Invoice number">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="invoice-status">Status</label>
        <select id="invoice-status" name="status">
          <option value="">Any status</option>
          <option>Draft</option>
          <option>Sent</option>
          <option>Overdue</option>
          <option>Paid</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button type="submit">Apply</button>
        <button type="reset">Reset</button>
      </div>
    </form>
    <p role="status">42 invoices</p>
  </search>
</div>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-filter-bar` | a `<search>` (`aria-label` when the page has several) |  |

Children: a `<form>` of fields (each a `data-field`, or a `<dui-combobox>`) whose last child holds the buttons, then a `role="status"` element with the result count.

#### Breakpoint

30rem of the bar's own inline size. A container query condition cannot read a custom property, so it is written as a length.

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves through the filters, then Apply and Reset |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | in a text field, applies the filters |

### Accessibility

- The status text says what changed ("24 orders match"), and is announced politely without moving focus (WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages).
- Controls keep their size (44px, 32px compact: above the 24px of WCAG 2.5.8).

### Specifications

- [HTML `<search>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/grouping-content.html#the-search-element)
- [WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html)
- [MDN `search`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/search)
- [MDN `status` role](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/status_role)
- [WCAG Labels or instructions](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/labels-or-instructions.html)

### See also

- [Organisms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/organisms/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/organisms/filter-bar.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/organisms/filter-bar.css), [`examples/organisms/filter-bar.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/organisms/filter-bar.html)
- Demos: Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- Apple Human Interface Guidelines: No equivalent
- [Material Design 3: Chips (filter chips)](https://m3.material.io/components/chips/overview)
- [Vercel Geist: Filter Params](https://vercel.com/geist/filter-params)

## Large forms

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/large-forms.html

Long forms split into labelled groups, in one or more columns.

_Diagram: A large form fills the content area as labelled groups of fields, in two columns on wide screens._

### Live example

#### New invoice

```html
<form data-form-sections aria-labelledby="invoice-title">
  <section aria-labelledby="inv-customer-title">
    <header>
      <h3 id="inv-customer-title">Customer</h3>
      <p>Who the invoice is addressed to.</p>
    </header>
    <div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-company">Company</label>
        <input type="text" id="inv-company" name="company" value="Orbital Mechanics GmbH" autocomplete="organization">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-contact">Contact email</label>
        <input type="email" id="inv-contact" name="contact" value="accounts@orbital-mechanics.example" autocomplete="email">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-vat">VAT number</label>
        <input type="text" id="inv-vat" name="vat" value="DE 123 456 789" autocomplete="off">
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="inv-details-title">
    <header>
      <h3 id="inv-details-title">Invoice details</h3>
      <p>Dates and references printed in the invoice header.</p>
    </header>
    <div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-date">Invoice date</label>
        <input type="date" id="inv-date" name="date" value="2025-03-14">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-due">Due date</label>
        <input type="date" id="inv-due" name="due" value="2025-04-13" aria-describedby="inv-due-hint">
        <p id="inv-due-hint" data-field="hint">30 days net, from the customer's payment terms.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-currency">Currency</label>
        <select id="inv-currency" name="currency">
          <option selected>EUR</option>
          <option>GBP</option>
          <option>USD</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-po">Customer reference</label>
        <input type="text" id="inv-po" name="po" value="PO-OM-4471" autocomplete="off">
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="inv-address-title">
    <header>
      <h3 id="inv-address-title">Billing address</h3>
      <p>Where the paper copy goes, if one is sent.</p>
    </header>
    <div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-street">Street and number</label>
        <input type="text" id="inv-street" name="street" value="Am Fallturm 1" autocomplete="address-line1">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-postcode">Postal code</label>
        <input type="text" id="inv-postcode" name="postcode" value="28359" autocomplete="postal-code">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-city">City</label>
        <input type="text" id="inv-city" name="city" value="Bremen" autocomplete="address-level2">
      </div>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-country">Country</label>
        <select id="inv-country" name="country" autocomplete="country">
          <option value="DE" selected>Germany</option>
          <option value="NL">Netherlands</option>
          <option value="GB">United Kingdom</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="inv-payment-title">
    <header>
      <h3 id="inv-payment-title">Payment</h3>
      <p>How the customer pays this invoice.</p>
    </header>
    <div>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Payment method</legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="method" value="transfer" checked> Bank transfer</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="method" value="debit"> Direct debit</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="method" value="card"> Card payment link</label>
      </fieldset>
      <div data-field>
        <label for="inv-notes">Note on the invoice</label>
        <textarea id="inv-notes" name="notes">Please quote INV-2025-0319 with your payment.</textarea>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <footer data-action-bar>
    <button type="submit">Create invoice</button>
    <button type="reset">Cancel</button>
  </footer>
</form>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-form-sections` | the `<form>` | each child `<section>` is a section: |
| `<header>` |  | its heading (h2) and an optional description `<p>` |
| `one body element` |  | a `<div>` (or `<fieldset>`) of fields, after the header |

#### Breakpoint

48rem of the form's own inline size. A container query condition cannot read a custom property, so it is written as a length.

#### Keyboard

Native keyboard behavior; see [HTML `<form>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-form-element).

### Accessibility

- Sections keep source order in both layouts, so the reading and Tab order stay top to bottom (WCAG 1.3.2, 2.4.3).
- Put the form's buttons in a data-action-bar at the end of the form so they stay in reach.
- Nothing scrolls sideways at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10).

### Specifications

- [HTML `<form>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-form-element)
- [HTML `<fieldset>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-fieldset-element)
- [WAI Forms tutorial](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/forms/)
- [WCAG 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/labels-or-instructions.html)
- [W3C grouping](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/forms/grouping/)
- [MDN Container queries](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Containment/Container_queries)

### See also

- [Organisms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/organisms/index.md)
- Source: [`css/components/organisms/large-forms.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/components/organisms/large-forms.css), [`examples/organisms/large-forms.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/organisms/large-forms.html)
- Demos: Account settings view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/settings.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/SettingsPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/settings), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/settings.astro))

- Apple Human Interface Guidelines: No equivalent
- Material Design 3: No equivalent
- Vercel Geist: No equivalent

## List-detail

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/list-detail.html

A list of items beside the details of the selected one, stacked on narrow screens.

**Our choice:** No standard exists: real links beside a detail region, placed with CSS grid, so history and URLs keep working.

_Diagram: List-detail splits the content area into a list of items and, beside it, the details of the selected one._

### Live example

#### Orders and the selected order

```html
<div data-list-detail>
  <nav aria-label="Orders">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="?order=1042" aria-current="page">Order 1042 <small>Ada Lovelace · €1,240.00</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?order=1041">Order 1041 <small>Alan Turing · €48.50</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?order=1040">Order 1040 <small>Grace Hopper · €310.25</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?order=1039">Order 1039 <small>Katherine Johnson · €72.00</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?order=1038">Order 1038 <small>Hedy Lamarr · €615.90</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?order=1037">Order 1037 <small>Margaret Hamilton · €2,105.00</small></a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <section aria-labelledby="order-1042-title" tabindex="0">
    <h3 id="order-1042-title">Order 1042</h3>
    <p><span data-badge="success">Shipped</span> Placed on 12 March 2025 by Ada Lovelace, Analytical Engines Ltd.</p>
    <dl>
      <dt>Ship to</dt>
      <dd>12 St James's Square, London SW1Y 4JH</dd>
      <dt>Carrier</dt>
      <dd>DHL Express, tracking 4207 1893 22</dd>
      <dt>Payment</dt>
      <dd>Invoice INV-2025-0318, due 11 April 2025</dd>
    </dl>
    <section data-scroll="inline" aria-labelledby="order-1042-lines" tabindex="0">
      <table>
        <caption id="order-1042-lines">Order lines</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr><th scope="col">Item</th><th scope="col">Quantity</th><th scope="col">Price</th><th scope="col">Total</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Brass gear set</td><td>4</td><td>€180.00</td><td>€720.00</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Punch card reader</td><td>1</td><td>€440.00</td><td>€440.00</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Shipping</td><td>1</td><td>€80.00</td><td>€80.00</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
    <p class="cluster">
      <a href="?order=1042&amp;view=new-invoice" data-button>Create invoice</a>
      <a href="?order=1042&amp;view=packing-slip" data-button>Print packing slip</a>
    </p>
  </section>
</div>
```

#### Customers, compact

```html
<div data-list-detail data-density="compact">
  <nav aria-label="Customers">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="?customer=c-118" aria-current="page">Analytical Engines Ltd. <small>London</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?customer=c-117">Bletchley Instruments <small>Milton Keynes</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?customer=c-116">Cobol Systems BV <small>Utrecht</small></a></li>
      <li><a href="?customer=c-115">Orbital Mechanics GmbH <small>Bremen</small></a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <article aria-labelledby="customer-118-title">
    <h3 id="customer-118-title">Analytical Engines Ltd.</h3>
    <dl>
      <dt>Contact</dt>
      <dd>Ada Lovelace, ada@analytical-engines.example</dd>
      <dt>Payment terms</dt>
      <dd>30 days net</dd>
      <dt>Open balance</dt>
      <dd>€1,240.00 (one invoice)</dd>
    </dl>
    <p><a href="?customer=c-118&amp;view=orders">All orders from Analytical Engines Ltd.</a></p>
  </article>
</div>
```

#### Settings page

```html
<div data-list-detail>
  <nav aria-label="Settings sections">
    <ul>
      <li><a href="#settings-company">Company</a></li>
      <li><a href="#settings-invoicing">Invoicing</a></li>
      <li><a href="#settings-notifications">Notifications</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <section aria-labelledby="settings-title" tabindex="0">
    <h3 id="settings-title">Settings</h3>
    <form data-form-sections aria-labelledby="settings-title">
      <section id="settings-company" aria-labelledby="settings-company-title">
        <header>
          <h4 id="settings-company-title">Company</h4>
          <p>Shown on invoices, quotes and delivery notes.</p>
        </header>
        <div>
            <div data-field>
              <label for="set-name">Legal name</label>
              <input type="text" id="set-name" name="name" value="Domestic Trading Ltd." autocomplete="organization">
            </div>
            <div data-field>
              <label for="set-vat">VAT number</label>
              <input type="text" id="set-vat" name="vat" value="NL 8123 4567 B01" autocomplete="off">
            </div>
            <div data-field>
              <label for="set-iban">IBAN</label>
              <input type="text" id="set-iban" name="iban" value="NL91 ABNA 0417 1643 00" autocomplete="off">
            </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section id="settings-invoicing" aria-labelledby="settings-invoicing-title">
        <header>
          <h4 id="settings-invoicing-title">Invoicing</h4>
          <p>Defaults for new invoices; each invoice can change them.</p>
        </header>
        <div>
            <div data-field>
              <label for="set-terms">Default payment terms</label>
              <select id="set-terms" name="terms">
                <option>14 days net</option>
                <option selected>30 days net</option>
                <option>60 days net</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div data-field>
              <label for="set-prefix">Invoice number prefix</label>
              <input type="text" id="set-prefix" name="prefix" value="INV-2025-" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="set-prefix-hint">
              <p id="set-prefix-hint" data-field="hint">The next invoice is INV-2025-0319.</p>
            </div>
            <div data-field>
              <label for="set-footer">Invoice footer</label>
              <textarea id="set-footer" name="footer">Thank you for your business. Please quote the invoice number with your payment.</textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section id="settings-notifications" aria-labelledby="settings-notifications-title">
        <header>
          <h4 id="settings-notifications-title">Notifications</h4>
          <p>Emails sent to the finance team.</p>
        </header>
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Email me when</legend>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="notify-overdue" checked> An invoice is overdue</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="notify-paid" checked> An invoice is paid</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="notify-credit"> A credit note is issued</label>
        </fieldset>
      </section>
      <footer data-action-bar>
        <button type="submit">Save settings</button>
        <button type="reset">Discard changes</button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </section>
</div>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute or value | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-list-detail` | the wrapper | the list beside (or above) the detail |
| `<nav aria-label> or <div>` |  | first child: the list, a `<ul>` or `<ol>` whose items are each one `<a href>` (or `<button>`) |
| `<section> or <article> with aria-labelledby` |  | second child: the detail |
| `aria-current="page"` | the selected link, or its `<li>` | the selected item |
| `aria-current="true"` | the selected `<button>`, or its `<li>` | the selected item |

#### Breakpoint

40rem of the wrapper's own inline size. A container query condition cannot read a custom property, so it is written as a length; to move it, write your own @container dui-list-detail rule.

#### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | moves through the list links, then into the detail pane |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | on a link, opens that item's detail |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | scroll the detail pane once it has focus |

### Accessibility

- Use buttons only when the detail has no URL of its own (a picker inside a dialog), with aria-current="true" on the selected one.
- It is shown like a selected data table row: a --dui-border-width-emphasis accent bar on its leading edge, a tint and bold text, so color is not the only cue (WCAG 1.4.1) and the bar has 3:1 against the surface (WCAG 1.4.11).
- In forced colors mode the tint is dropped by the browser and the bar is drawn in Highlight, so the marker stays.
- Rows are at least --dui-size-control tall (44px, 32px compact; WCAG 2.5.8).
- Give it tabindex="0" when it can scroll, so keyboard users can scroll it (WCAG 2.1.1).
- Source order is list, then detail, which is also the reading and Tab order in both layouts (WCAG 1.3.2, 2.4.3).
- When a link loads a new detail, move focus to the detail's heading or leave it on the link; never move it without a page load.

### Specifications

- [MDN CSS grid layout](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Grid_layout)
- [WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html)
- [MDN Container queries](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Containment/Container_queries)
- [MDN `aria-current`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-current)
- [WCAG Meaningful sequence](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/meaningful-sequence.html)
- [WCAG Use of color](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html)
- [WCAG Non text contrast](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-contrast.html)
- [MDN `forced-colors`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/forced-colors)

### See also

- [Layouts](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/index.md)
- Source: [`css/layout/list-detail.css`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/css/layout/list-detail.css), [`examples/layouts/list-detail.html`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/examples/layouts/list-detail.html)
- Demos: Orders view ([Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/vanilla/orders.html), [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/react/src/OrdersPage.tsx), [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular/src/app/orders), [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/blob/main/demos/astro/src/pages/orders.astro))

### How other systems do it

For comparison only; these are not the standard this system follows.

- [Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Split views](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views)
- [Material Design 3: Canonical layout examples: List-detail](https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/canonical-examples/list-detail)
- Vercel Geist: No equivalent

## Split

Page: https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/split.html

Two regions side by side at a set ratio, stacked on narrow screens.

**Our choice:** No standard exists for a fixed split: two regions in a CSS grid. A draggable divider would follow the APG Window Splitter pattern.

_Diagram: A split puts two regions side by side in the content area at a set ratio, such as an invoice and its payments at two to one._

### Live example

#### Invoice and payments (2:1)

```html
<div data-split="2:1">
  <section aria-labelledby="invoice-title">
    <h3 id="invoice-title">Invoice INV-2025-0318</h3>
    <p>Analytical Engines Ltd., issued 12 March 2025, due 11 April 2025.</p>
    <section data-scroll="inline" aria-labelledby="invoice-lines" tabindex="0">
      <table>
        <caption id="invoice-lines">Invoice lines</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr><th scope="col">Description</th><th scope="col">Quantity</th><th scope="col">Amount</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Brass gear set</td><td>4</td><td>€720.00</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Punch card reader</td><td>1</td><td>€440.00</td></tr>
```
